blocked.detail: MP-1: the original Craig source-proof presentation of interpolation, owed separately from the derived truth-table construction, is absent from the route, and its source is not held. held-sources.json has no Craig1957 entry; for interpolation it holds only Maehara1960. Needed: Craig, W., 'Linear Reasoning. A New Form of the Herbrand-Gentzen Theorem', JSL 22(3), 1957, pp. 250-268, and 'Three Uses of the Herbrand-Gentzen Theorem in Relating Model Theory and Proof Theory', JSL 22(3), 1957, pp. 269-285 (bib Craig1957, doi 10.2307/2963594).
